tha-ap432:1.1: Sovaṇṇakattarika.] Manobhāvaniyaṃ Buddham attadantaṃ samāhitaṃ / iriyamānaṃ brahmapathe citta-vūpasame rataṃ // //
tha-ap432:2.1: Nittiṇṇa-oghaṃ sambuddhaṃ jhāyi-jhānarataṃ muniṃ / upaviṭṭhaṃ samāpannam indīvaradalappabhaṃ // //
tha-ap432:3.1: Alābun' odakaṃ gayha Buddhaseṭṭham upāgamiṃ / Buddhassa pāde dhovitvā alābukam adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap432:4.1: Āṇāpesi ca sambuddho Padamuttaranāyako / imin' odakam āhatvā pādamūle ṭhapehi me. // //
tha-ap432:5.1: Sādhūti 'haṃ paṭissutvā satthu gāravatāya ca / udakaṃ lābun' āhatvā Buddhaseṭṭham upānayiṃ. // //
tha-ap432:6.1: Anumodi mahāvīro cittaṃ nibbāpayaṃ mamaṃ: / ‘iminā lābudānena saṅkappo te samijjhatu.' // //
tha-ap432:7.1: Pannarasesu kappesu devaloke ramiṃ ahaṃ / tiṃsatikkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī ahos' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap432:8.1: Diva vā yadi vā rattiṃ caṅkamantassa tiṭṭhato / sovaṇṇaṃ kattaraṃ gayha tiṭṭhati purato mama. // //
tha-ap432:9.1: Buddhassa datvāna lābuṃ labhāmi soṇṇakattaraṃ / appakampikataṃ kāraṃ vipulaṃ hoti tādisaṃ. // //
tha-ap432:10.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yam alābum adaṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi alābussa idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap432:14.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sovaṇṇakattariko th. i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap432:18.1: Sakiṃsammajjako thero Ekadussī tath' Āsanī Kadamba-Koraṇḍa tadā Ghataṃ Savaniko pi ca
tha-ap432:19.1: Sucintito Kiṅkhaniko Soṇṇa-kattariko pi ca ekaṃ gāthāsatañ c' ettha ekasattati-m-eva ca.
